title: Account for the sale of receivables and use as collateral for borrowing

items.concept: Secured borrowing life cycle: initial loan JE, loan schedule, period-end interest/remittance JEs (emphasis), final NP settlement
Number-variant twin of secured borrowing life cycle with period-end interest/remittance adjusting JEs
Factoring without/with recourse initial recognition; holdback and recourse settlement; note discounting disposal
Classify arrangement as sale of receivables vs secured borrowing (control criteria)
Measure loss on sale of receivables with recourse (fee + recourse liability)
